scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 3 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 42s).

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent verified customer identity within the required time window.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Use customer information and context to tailor the conversation and show understanding of their needs.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Acknowledge the customer's concern with a genuine expression of empathy, such as 'I can imagine how frustrating that must be for you.'

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent accurately acknowledged and mirrored the customer's reported issue.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent practiced active listening without repetitive or redundant questions.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Clearly state your intention to resolve the issue and take responsibility for finding a solution.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Use positive body language and verbal cues, such as smiling and using the customer's name, to establish trust and rapport.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask open-ended questions that encourage the customer to share more information about their issue, starting with 'Can you tell me more about...' or 'How did this happen?'

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly ask the customer if they feel the issue has been fully addressed and are satisfied with the resolution.
